summary: CreatorOS v3 (per-user scoping + onboarding wizard) — ALL GREEN. Backend: 26/26 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_v3_isolation.py — 14 protected endpoints correctly 401 without Bearer, 4 public endpoints (/, /integrations/stripe/status, /integrations/youtube/channel, /competitors/list) open, user A's namespace seeded via seed_user_starter returns 6 assets while B sees 0 (data isolation), POST /api/portfolio with A's token creates asset with user_id=A in Mongo and is NOT visible to B, seeding B independently yields 6 assets for B while A retains its own set, onboarding status returns {complete:false, youtube_handle:null, youtube_api_configured:bool}, POST /api/onboarding/complete with '@testhandle' returns youtube_handle='testhandle' (@ stripped) and follow-up GET reflects complete:true, dashboard greeting uses first name ('Welcome back, Alice'), AI chat history is scoped so user B does NOT see user A's session_id='s1' message, strategy plans scoped by user_id (A's plan invisible to B). Frontend: unauthenticated / redirects to /login (login-google-btn present); injecting onboarding-incomplete synthetic user (user_ui_v3_onboarding, name='Charlie Onboard') redirects / -> /onboarding; wizard flow verified end-to-end — Step1 'Get started' -> Step2 (onboarding-yt-input + onboarding-yt-lookup present) fills 'testhandle' -> Continue -> Step3 (Stripe copy) -> Finish -> Step4 headline 'All set.' + 'Enter CreatorOS' button -> tap calls /api/onboarding/complete, AuthContext.refreshUser() re-fetches user with onboarding_complete=true, Gate auto-navigates to /(tabs); Dashboard shows 'Welcome back, Charlie' (NOT the legacy 'Welcome back, Maya'), hero score 87 with 4 sub-scores 91/84/88/79 and 2 alerts rendering from user's seeded namespace; onboarded synthetic user visiting /login or /onboarding is redirected to /(tabs); Profile sign-out-btn clears localStorage['creatoros_session_token'] and returns to /login. All 5 tabs (Home/Portfolio/AI Coach/Finance/Profile) render in tab bar (verified in dashboard screenshot). No red-screen errors. No new deprecated Expo packages introduced. Only remaining warning is the same benign pointerEvents deprecation noted in iter_3.

react_native_issues.issue: Existing (from iter_3, not v3-introduced) console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking. Reference: repeated across (tabs)/* and onboarding.tsx Pressables.

action_items: OPTIONAL cleanup: purge synthetic UI test sessions left in Mongo after testing: db.user_sessions.delete_many({session_token:{$regex:'^ui-v3-token-'}}); db.users.delete_many({user_id:{$regex:'^user_ui_v3_'}}); db.assets.delete_many({user_id:{$regex:'^user_ui_v3_'}}); db.goals.delete_many({user_id:{$regex:'^user_ui_v3_'}}); db.content.delete_many({user_id:{$regex:'^user_ui_v3_'}}); db.recommendations.delete_many({user_id:{$regex:'^user_ui_v3_'}}).
OPTIONAL (carryover from iter_3): migrate remaining Pressable/View usages of the deprecated pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:209 — make_auth_router is wired with on_new_user=seed_user_starter and only fires when the users doc did not previously exist. Idempotent — seed_user_starter early-returns if assets already exist for that user_id.

server.py — every data endpoint has `user: dict = Depends(current_user)` and filters Mongo by {user_id: user['user_id']}. No accidental cross-tenant leaks. PROJECTION={_id:0} used everywhere so ObjectId never leaks.
server.py:374 — onboarding_complete correctly strips leading '@' via lstrip('@'). Only sets youtube_handle if payload provided (safe optional).

server.py:417 — chat session_id is namespaced as f"{user_id}::{session_id}" — this is the actual isolation boundary; two users with the same session_id string cannot collide. Also filters db.chat_messages by both user_id and scoped_session (defence-in-depth).

auth.py:105 — is_new hook only fires for brand-new users (existing None), which is exactly the desired 'first sign-in' semantics. Try/except around on_new_user prevents seed failures from breaking auth.
strategy.py — user-scoped list/get/POST via {user_id: user['user_id']}. Correct.
_layout.tsx Gate — handles all 4 states (loading / unauth / authed-incomplete / authed-complete) with router.replace to avoid history stacking. Correct redirect targets.
onboarding.tsx — after finish, calls api.onboardingComplete then refreshUser; relies on Gate effect to route to /(tabs). No manual router.replace needed. Clean.
AuthContext.tsx — refreshUser correctly re-hits /api/auth/me with current bearer and updates the user state so onboarding_complete flips true reactively.

success_rate.backend: 100% (26/26 v3 tests, plus prior 25 still valid)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — /login gate, onboarding gate, 3-step wizard incl. Finish → /(tabs), user-specific dashboard greeting, onboarded-user redirect, sign-out flow all pass

seed_data_creation: Backend test fixture creates two ephemeral users user_v3_a_* and user_v3_b_* with 1-day tokens; they self-cleanup via fixture teardown (deletes users, sessions, assets, goals, content, recommendations, chat_messages, strategy_plans). For frontend UI tests, two persistent synthetic users were injected in Mongo: (a) user_ui_v3_onboarding / token 'ui-v3-token-onboarding' / name 'Charlie Onboard' / onboarding_complete=false, and (b) user_ui_v3_complete / token 'ui-v3-token-complete' / name 'Dana Complete' / onboarding_complete=true. Both were seeded with the starter dataset. Cleanup command is in action_items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v3 acceptance criteria fully met. To bypass /login in web UI, use `localStorage['creatoros_session_token']='ui-v3-token-complete'` (already inserted; onboarding_complete=true, seeded with starter data, name='Dana Complete'). Use 'ui-v3-token-onboarding' (name='Charlie Onboard', onboarding_complete=false) to re-test the wizard from step 1. Tokens are 1-day TTL — refresh via: python3 -c "from pymongo import MongoClient; from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta; import os; from dotenv import load_dotenv; load_dotenv('/app/backend/.env'); c=MongoClient(os.environ['MONGO_URL']); db=c[os.environ['DB_NAME']]; now=datetime.now(timezone.utc); [db.user_sessions.update_one({'session_token':t},{'$set':{'expires_at':now+timedelta(days=1)}}) for t in ('ui-v3-token-complete','ui-v3-token-onboarding')]". IMPORTANT — after setting localStorage in Playwright, do a full page.goto() (not just reload) so AuthProvider bootstraps with the new token; setting localStorage before goto in the SAME browser context sometimes races the AuthProvider mount. Backend intentional non-200s: /api/integrations/stripe/status returns connected:false (placeholder key); /api/integrations/youtube/channel returns 503 when YOUTUBE_API_KEY unset; /api/auth/me returns 401 without bearer. Claude Sonnet 4.5 (chat + strategy) is live.
